rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user by matching full name and corrected ZIP code to a single account before accessing order data. However, the final answer likely relied on an unsupported inference. The tool output shown includes line item prices but no explicit total, taxes, shipping, or discounts. The agent stated, “You paid a total of $829.43,” which matches the sum of the two item prices, suggesting it may have omitted taxes, shipping, or discounts and thus could be fabricated or incomplete relative to the tool data. Additionally, the agent assumed which order was “most recent” without verifying dates; while plausible from the ID sequence, it wasn’t confirmed via order timestamps. Because policy requires giving correct, supported final information and not inventing missing facts, this response does not meet the pass bar.
